# Leveling a Mage — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on arcane (1 member), fire (10 members), frost (20 members). The main line is **frost** — Build (levels 10-60), 10/0/41, no respec. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/mage/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Arcane

- **MA07f-frost-nova-runner:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Frost Nova roots a runner still within its 10 yd, so it cannot reach help; the melee then finish it.
- **MA15f-frostbolt-runner:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Frostbolt on a runner beyond Frost Nova's reach: its slow keeps the runner from getting far. HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term.
- **MA00i-mage-armor:** Because the three armours are mutually exclusive auras, MA01 and MA02 gain `not aura_self(6117)` in the same patch: with Mage Armor up they must not overwrite it, and the outcome the player sees is that the mage wears the guide's armour for the bracket it is in.
- **MA01-frost-armor:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **MA02-ice-armor:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **MA03-arcane-intellect:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **MA04-mana-shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **MA04p-polymorph-moon:** Polymorph-able is spell 118's own TargetCreatureType: beast (1), humanoid (7) or critter (8), so a Molten Elemental (4) is never marked and never sheeped here. Two branches, so it never re-casts on a sheep with time left: a mob with no sheep aura (any of the four ranks 118, 12824, 12825, 12826) is sheeped while two or more enemies are engaged on the party (the marked mob itself counts once it is awake and attacking, a sheeped one attacks nobody, so the second case needs one other enemy: the last mob standing is never sheeped); a mob that carries the sheep is sheeped again only under 3 s left (target.aura_ms, v17) and while at least one other enemy is engaged.
- **MA04s-polymorph-second:** `target: other_engaged` (v10), a hostile that attacks the resident and is not the target; beast, humanoid or critter only (spell 118's TargetCreatureType, as the party rule); two enemies engaged, none sheeped within 40 yd (one Polymorph per caster; Frost Nova, Arcane Explosion and the rest already carry `not sheeped_within`, so they do not break it); standing; 60 mana (rank 1) and 30 per cent of the bar.
- **MA07-counterspell:** The interrupt: 100 mana, instant, 30 yd, 30 s categoryRecoveryTime. No substitute exists: 2139 has no lower rank and no other mage spell interrupts at the pin (OQ-2743).
- **MA07-counterspell-t1:** Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers). 193 adds the Atal'ai camp casts the boss rows lack: Heal 11642, Sleep 12098, Summon 12151 (DB, docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-192.result.txt).
- **MA07-counterspell-t2:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of MA07-counterspell, tier 2 of 3 (rank 2, fears, charms, polymorphs, stuns and sleeps; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **MA07-counterspell-t3:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of MA07-counterspell, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). Same when and same spell; the view takes only a caster whose interruptible cast is one of the listed ids, so the kick goes to a heal, then a fear, charm, polymorph, stun or sleep, then a summon or channel, then the nearest caster (the plain rule, which keeps nukes and fillers).
- **MA10m-remove-lesser-curse-must:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **MA10-remove-lesser-curse:** Free at the pin; DispelType 2 is curse. The mage's only curse removal, for the reason the frost file records: skill_line_ability gives 475 class_mask 128 (mage) and Remove Curse 2782 class_mask 1024 (druid), and the core class-fits a taught spell by that mask whatever a trainer lists.
- **MA00s-peel-11197:** Other Stratholme Undead adds are not sourced.
- **MA00s-caster-first-10499:** Its spell list (tkbplay-201.result.txt: 104990, Wail of Souls 17631, 7,580-8,059 hp, level 58-60) is instant and not interruptible per p4-group (spell_template: castingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0; not re-read here), so no interrupt rule can answer it and killing it is the only kit answer; same shape and gates as the 10471 rule, just ahead of it.
- **MA00s-caster-first-10471:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **MA00s-caster-first-10470:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **MA11-arcane-surge:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. Turtle content, and one of three rules in this workstream that use aura_state for what the vocabulary added it for; the other two are Riposte and Surprise Attack in the combat rogue file.
- **MA15s-frostbolt-slow:** The chill is the Frostbolt aura under its own spell id (116, 205, 837, 7322, 8406, 8407, 8408 for ranks 1 to 7, DB) and a Nova root (122, 865) also counts as slowed; the rule is the opener only, so it needs the mob still more than 10 yd away and still at 90 per cent health or more (nothing has hurt it yet; a dying mob is the wand or Fire Blast case), and it stops at 40 where the guide switches to the Missiles turret (L211).
- **MA12-arcane-rupture:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. Turtle content and the core of the spec: an Arcane talent (45) at 20, 80 mana, a 2500 ms cast on a 15 s categoryRecoveryTime, whose script casts Arcane Rupture (52502) on the mage when it finishes, and that aura carries a damage modifier masked to Arcane Missiles.
- **MA16w-shoot-trash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: the mage spends to empty on every trash fight, 28 of 56 fights under 20 per cent in round 86, and drinks after almost every pull; wand earlier on trash, keep full nukes for bosses and big pulls): the wand instead of a nuke when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the mage is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull. Boss and big-pull test, from what a rule can read in combat: `not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)` (a target the party will take 15 s or more to kill is a long fight; null reads true, so a fresh target is trash until it proves otherwise) and `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3` (a pack of four or more keeps the nukes and the area spells).
- **MA13c-missiles-clearcasting:** Clearcasting is aura 12536 (DB: a self aura, 8 s, cost-reducing, effect aura 108; the Arcane Concentration proc, leveling.md L163 and L164 call it the Clearcasting that makes the next spell free). Not inside Arcane Power (aura 12042), where the page order is Rupture, then Missiles (L122, L123).
- **MA13-arcane-missiles:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MA15-frostbolt:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. HO-TKB-PLAY-189 (HO-188): not on Noxxion (13282, Razorfen Downs boss), whose creature_template school_immune_mask is 16 = frost `db:penqle_world.creature_template@tkbplay-189`; a stopgap until p1-loop's target.school_immune(k) (v40) lands, then it is replaced by the vocabulary term.
- **MA15a-fireball:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MA16-shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031): also while a ritual is on below 40 per cent mana (not on a boss), where the spenders hold back for the area wave. Measured on d-20260917T070130Z-p3, actor 358: the wand was 26 per cent of the mage''s casts, 86 per cent of its starts were unasked, 7 ticks were wand-locked, and 35 of its own casts came back SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED -- the bot''s own movement cancelling its own auto-repeat.
- **MA17-evocation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **MA00d-conjure-water-1:** HO-TKB-PLAY-041 (orchestrator, the owner's conformance question, round 63): every mage of the cohort KNOWS Conjure Water and Conjure Food (10 of 10 at level 10 to 13) and none holds a conjured item, none has a rule for the spell, and all ten are broke (median about 900 copper) and buy their water.
